cc:Work.dc:description: Matched complete logical T caps for all 27 frozen synthetic contracts. I hold the financial circuit, comparison flag, probability prior, probability tolerance and 99 per cent per-price confidence fixed while changing the amplitude estimator. Left, on logarithmic axes: the canonical QPE amplitude-estimation cap against the retained iterative-controller cap, with equal-cap reference line. Right, with a logarithmic ratio axis: their exact T-cap ratio against the QPE phase-register width, with ratio-one reference. Colours identify asset count and marker shapes identify payoff cap H. Concentric marker sizes distinguish nearly coincident cases without moving any coordinate; sizes do not encode resource amounts. The exact case-labelled rows are retained separately. The QPE caps include the emitted controlled oracle, actual certified Clifford and T inverse Fourier tapes, confidence amplification and the compiled norm-error allowance rounded upwards on a 2^-80 grid. Phase-register width is not an exact increase in peak qubits: both peak-qubit figures are conservative bounds. These are proved resource upper caps rather than measured running times or a practical quantum advantage; the classical financial tolerance is already certified for these contracts.
